verified.old_course_not_passed: The completed course does not have a passing grade in the transcript.
verified.similarity_below_threshold: The overall syllabus similarity is below the required percentage.
verified.credit_hours_lower: The completed course has fewer credit hours than the requested course.
verified.level_mismatch: The completed course is at a lower academic level than the requested course.
verified.missing_course_topics: Topics of the requested course are not covered by the completed course.
verified.grade_below_minimum: The grade of the completed course is below the minimum grade required for equivalency.
verified.course_not_in_study_plan: The requested course is not part of the student's study plan.
verified.transfer_credit_limit_exceeded: Approving the request would exceed the maximum number of transferable credit hours.
verified.program_change_rejected: The student's program change to the program that offers the requested course was rejected.

judged.learning_outcomes_gap: The learning outcomes of the requested course are not met by the completed course.
judged.assessment_structure_differs: The way the two courses are assessed differs significantly.
judged.different_course_focus: The two courses have a different focus or emphasis.
judged.insufficient_syllabus_detail: The syllabus does not give enough detail to support equivalency.
